notes.title: The First Week
notes.content:
During these four days, The Lovebirds' Demo already had an unexpectedly high amount of downloads

The Lovebirds Demo has now been available for four days and so far there hasn't been much reports of any major bugs. I'm currently working on the full version, of course, but this month there is planned to be an update with some minor bug fixes in the demo version. 

If you're interested in supporting Cafearatus Studios, I have a Game Jolt and an Itch.io page with the pay what you want pricing method, so you can donate the amount of money you wish to give. Every single penny will be spent on developing the full version of The Lovebirds!

Thanks to everybody who has tried the demo and added The Lovebirds to their wishlist! Looking forward to hearing more feedback from you!

notes.title: You and The Lovebirds
notes.content:
Do you believe that you can face your fears?
Do you believe that you truly even know your fears?

The average amount of remotely conscious decisions an adult makes each day equals about 35,000.

How many of these choices will cause some sort of chaos?

All of these decisions are based on your ability to choose between two things. There might be multiple options at first, but after a while there will always be only two things left... One is often a bit more evil and the other one is often a bit better. Which one do you choose?

It doesn't always matter, because you will never know for sure which one is which.

However, don't worry... Everybody is sometimes a little bit lost...
But in May 2019, you will be able to find your true self.

Maybe that person is what you're the most afraid of. 

Sincerely,

???????????????
